our_interpretation: Read the statement in its immediate context as an observation about the reported cost trajectory from 2024 into the 2025 spending plan, as understood at publication.
The context supplies calendar years, so the comparison period covers 2024 and 2025 rather than an invented quarterly comparison.
Dramatically means a large, unmistakable increase, not a small fluctuation. The speaker supplies no exact percentage threshold.
Compute expenditure is the concrete measure used in the surrounding argument. It includes training, research and inference.
A forecast of full-year spending must remain identified as a forecast; it is not money already spent.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable financial reporting establishes a large increase from 2024 compute expenditure to the 2025 spending estimate current at publication, or matched realized costs establish the same trajectory during the described period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish broadly flat or falling expenditure and show that the apparent large increase results from incompatible definitions, periods or mistaken figures.
